reasoning_content:
The `/proposals/new` without a projekt_phase_id fails with 500 because @projekt_phase is nil and the template calls @projekt_phase.projekt. But this may be an app bug (the fork expects a projekt_phase). Let me test with a valid projekt_phase_id.

Actually, wait — the controller redirects to proposals_path if @projekt_phase.blank? AND no selectable top-level projects. If projects exist, it proceeds. Let me test with valid projekt_phase_id.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && T=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=verified@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; for u in "/proposals/new" "/proposals/new?projekt_phase_id=3" "/proposals/new?projekt_id=9&projekt_phase_id=3"; do echo -n "$u -> "; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /tmp/nf.html -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:3000$u"; done
